params.body:
The next demo is Bextrust's own company, on a gate in sealed hardware, as the Acme demo's gate runs. The section added on 9 November assumed the gate might leave Confidential Space until a pilot; that is not the plan, so the paragraph goes.

The section was also numbered 9, beside the existing "9. Demo story work". It is now 10, and the two references to it follow.
params.title: HANDOVER: the next demo is our own company, in sealed hardware
